title: Virupaksha
desc: While the occurrence of a series of mysterious deaths haunt the villagers, a man decides to risk his life and unravel the secret behind them.

title: Kirik Party
desc: Karna, a first-year engineering student, falls in love with Saanvi, a final-year pupil from his college. However, a tragic event changes his perception towards life and he mends his ways.

title: Mr. Perfect
desc: Vicky breaks his engagement with Priya, his childhood friend, after he learns that she is making many compromises for his sake. However, time makes him realise the need for compromises in life.

title: Ayogya
desc: Siddhe Gowda, an unemployed young man, decides to run against Bachche Gowda, the village head, in the local election. He also begins to fall in love with Nandini, the daughter of a marriage broker.

title: Namma Kutumba
desc: A six-year-old boy loses his parents in a car accident prior to their divorce. However, 30 years later, he comes across two youngsters who resemble them and decides to unite them.

title: Mungaru Male 2
desc: Preetham, the son of Suryakanth, a millionaire, is driven by excitement and easily gets bored when it comes to relationships. He understands love after he meets Nandini.

title: Jigarthanda
desc: A budding director tries to research a merciless gangster for making a film on gangsterism. But his secret attempts to conduct the research fail when he gets caught for snooping.

title: Shiva Shakthi
desc: Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati fall in love at the start of the universe. Their eternal love story becomes a legendary tale of devotion for future generations.
